concepts.title: Generator of a finite continuous-time Markov chain
concepts.description: The real matrix Q with Q(x,y)=lim_{h↓0}(P_h(x,y)−1_{x=y})/h, nonnegative off-diagonal entries and zero row sums; off-diagonal entries are jump rates.

concepts.title: Geometric Brownian motion
concepts.description: The process S_t=S₀exp((μ−σ²/2)t+σB_t), equivalently the solution of dS_t=μS_tdt+σS_tdB_t for S₀>0.

concepts.title: Geometric distribution on positive integers
concepts.description: For 0<p≤1, P(G=k)=p(1−p)^(k−1) for k=1,2,…; G counts trials up to and including the first success. Its tail is P(G>k)=(1−p)^k.

concepts.title: Spectral-gap bound for pure drift on randomly rewired cycle arcs
concepts.description: Let k arc lengths be independent Geometric(1/L) variables,with k,L→∞ and fixed 0<ρ_l<log L/log k<ρ_u<∞. For the pure drift chain that moves along arcs and chooses the next arc uniformly at endpoints, every γ>4 gives absolute spectral gap greater than 1/(L(log k)^γ) with high probability; the exceptional probability is O(k^(−c)L^(−d)) for any fixed c,d>0. Conditioning the total number of vertices to be n gives the same high-probability bound for the uniformly cut-cycle model with L=n/k.

concepts.title: Decay of boundary influence for Gibbs measures on trees
concepts.description: On rooted factor trees, the root marginal changes by arbitrarily little in total variation under every possible boundary condition at sufficiently large distance. This uniform condition yields uniqueness of the limiting root marginal.

concepts.title: Gibbs distribution on a finite configuration space
concepts.description: For a finite set Ω, energy H:Ω→ℝ and inverse temperature β≥0, the Gibbs distribution is μ(σ)=exp(−βH(σ))/Z, where Z=∑_{τ∈Ω}exp(−βH(τ)).

concepts.title: Girsanov change of measure for constant Brownian drift
concepts.description: On Brownian paths up to T, changing measure by exp(−νB_T−ν²T/2) makes B_t+νt standard Brownian motion for 0≤t≤T.

concepts.title: Graph distance
concepts.description: The distance between two vertices is the minimum length of a path joining them, or infinity if no such path exists.

concepts.title: Girth of a graph
concepts.description: The length of a shortest cycle, with girth infinity for an acyclic graph. In a multigraph a loop has length one and two parallel edges form a cycle of length two.

concepts.title: Path in an undirected graph
concepts.description: A finite sequence of adjacent edges joining successive vertices; a simple path has no repeated vertex. Its length is the number of edges.

concepts.title: Greatest lower bound
concepts.description: For a subset A of a partially ordered set, its greatest lower bound is a lower bound of A lying above every lower bound of A, when one exists.

concepts.title: Integral Grönwall inequality
concepts.description: If u is nonnegative and continuous on [0,T], a≥0, b≥0 is integrable, and u(t)≤a+∫₀ᵗb(s)u(s)ds for every t, then u(t)≤a exp(∫₀ᵗb(s)ds) for every t∈[0,T].

concepts.title: Halting set for total variation mixing
concepts.description: For a Markov chain with specified initial distribution, a set A is halting for total variation if d_TV(Law(X_t),π)≤P(T_A>t) for every t≥0.

concepts.title: Heilmann–Lieb real-rootedness theorem for matching polynomials
concepts.description: For a finite graph with nonnegative edge weights, the matching polynomial μ_G(x)=∑_D(−1)^{|D|}(∏_{e∈D}w_e)x^{|V|−2|D|} has only real zeros. Equivalently the monomer-activity partition polynomial with positive dimer activities has its zeros on the imaginary axis.

concepts.title: Hilbert-valued Q-Wiener process
concepts.description: A continuous Hilbert-space-valued process with independent Gaussian increments, mean zero and covariance (t−s)Q, where Q is nonnegative self-adjoint and trace class. An eigenbasis expansion is ∑_k√q_kβ_k(t)e_k with ∑_kq_k<∞.

concepts.title: Hille–Yosida theorem for contraction semigroups
concepts.description: A densely defined operator A on a Banach space generates a strongly continuous contraction semigroup exactly when it is closed, every λ>0 belongs to its resolvent, and ‖(λI−A)^{-n}‖≤λ^{-n} for every integer n≥1. Its resolvent is the Laplace transform∫₀∞e^{-λt}T_tdt.

concepts.title: Hitting time of a set for a Markov chain
concepts.description: For A in the state space, T_A=inf{t≥0:X_t∈A}, with infinity if A is never visited. The starting state or initial law is specified separately.

concepts.title: Hoeffding’s lemma
concepts.description: If a≤X≤b almost surely and EX=0, then Eexp(tX)≤exp(t²(b−a)²/8) for every real t.
